name: Avani Javia
tagline: Top rated Business & Corporate attorney in Dallas, Texas
education: Texas A&M University School of Law
about: A beacon of hope for her clients in the face of mounting legal challenges, Avani Javia utilizes her shrewd legal acumen and expansive practical knowledge to help them overcome said challenges with grace and poise. At Fears Law in Dallas, Texas, she is well-versed in handling myriad facets of business and corporate law, as well as estate planning.

Ms. Javia graduated from The University of Texas at Austin with her Bachelor of Science degree in actuarial science and a minor in the Business Foundations Program. She went on to attend the Texas A&M University School of Law where she received her Juris Doctor degree, along with a certificate in business law concentration. Avani is licensed to represent clients in Texas.

A relentless advocate for her clients' goals, Ms. Javia explores every legal avenue to secure the peace of mind they deserve. She has garnered the adulation and praise of her fellow peers for constantly progressing the standard of client care in her industry to even greater heights through her affiliations with the Texas Young Lawyers Association and the State Bar of Texas (SBT). Furthermore, at the SBT, she is a member of the Business Law Section, and the Women and the Law Section.
